svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 18 mm birch plywood to 1,200 x 600 mm, square within 0.5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes (shown on the hole layout, not here): 1,008 on a 25 mm grid, first

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centres 12.5 mm from the left and front edges; 756 plain 6.6 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 130 at 8.0 mm for tee nuts, 122 at 8.5 mm for screw-in inserts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill on a shared CNC router, or with a printed drilling template

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: indexed from the left and front edges, never from the last hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tile pocket: 301 x 301 mm right through, 824.5 to 1,125.5 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: left edge and 149.5 to 450.5 mm from the front edge. Drill an 8 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: relief hole on each corner first, then jigsaw and rout to the line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Round all edges 1 mm; seal both faces with a thin finish.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the aprons and rails, held by nine steel brackets from below.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: corner to corner diagonals equal within 1 mm.
